# Elai

Elai is an AI video generation platform for creating, personalizing, translating, and rendering presenter-led videos from text, templates, and uploaded media.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/elai/.

## Actions

- **Copy Video**: Create a draft copy of an existing video or template.
- **Create Story Video**: Create a Story video from text, HTML, or a web-page URL and generate its visual slides so it is ready for rendering.
- **Delete Video**: Permanently delete one Elai video or template.
- **Estimate Speech Duration** (read-only): Estimate how many seconds narration text will take with a selected Elai voice before modifying or rendering a video.
- **Get Video** (read-only): Get a video's status, render URL, metadata, and optionally its full slide configuration.
- **List Avatars** (read-only): Find available avatars and variants as compact records, optionally limited to Realtime-compatible avatars.
- **List Videos** (read-only): List videos and templates as compact summaries, with filters and a continuation cursor for additional pages.
- **Render Video**: Start asynchronous rendering of a prepared video, consuming paid rendering minutes.
